lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The great doors creak open. General Mo stands before the throne, sword drawn.

lines.speaker: general_mo
lines.en: Halt. None of you may go in.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: We must unite! All of us. Look behind me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Behind you stand elves, dwarves, beastfolk and dragons: a friend from every realm.

lines.speaker: fei
lines.en: We're friends, so we came together.
lines.zh: 我们是朋友，所以我们一起来了。
lines.zhTrad: 我們是朋友，所以我們一起來了。

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: Because we have courage, and we trust our partners.
lines.zh: 因为我们有勇气，而且我们信任伙伴。
lines.zhTrad: 因為我們有勇氣，而且我們信任夥伴。

lines.speaker: general_mo
lines.en: At the Colosseum you fought fairly. A knight serves his king... but a knight also chooses.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: What do you say to General Mo?

lines.speaker: general_mo
lines.en: Go. I will guard this door so that no one runs away. Not even him.

lines.speaker: general_mo
lines.en: Partner... Hm. Perhaps, after. For now I guard this door.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: One last time, my dears. Are you ready?
lines.zh: 最后一次了。准备好了吗？
lines.zhTrad: 最後一次了。準備好了嗎？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The Harmony Bell hums in your pack. Far above, the Demon King rises from his throne.
